test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If three metallic spheres of radii 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm respectively are melted to form a single sphere, then what will be the volume of the new sphere? [Use π = 22over 7]
solution:
**Given:**

If three metallic spheres of radii are 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm.

**Formula used:**

Volume = 4/3πr³

**Calculation:**

Volume of three sphere = volume of a new sphere.

⇒ Volume of a new sphere = 4/3π3³ + 4/3π4² + 4/3π5³

⇒ Volume of a new sphere = 4/3π(33 + 4³ + 5³)

⇒ Volume of a new sphere = 4/3π(27 + 64 + 125)

⇒ 4/3π(216)

⇒ 4/3 × 22/7 × (216)

⇒ 4 × 22/7 × (72)

⇒ 905{1over7} cm3

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
